title: Redesign with Apple Ecosystem Typography, Premium Palette, Responsive Hero Carousel, and Frame Studio Reordering
description: Refactor global color tokens to Apple's signature luxury palette (#F5F5F7 canvas, #1D1D1F typography, #86868B secondary, #D2D2D7 borders), apply Apple SF Pro typography stack, build a responsive touch-enabled Hero Image Carousel, and position the Interactive Custom Frame Studio right below it.
acceptanceCriteria: globals.css and layout.tsx updated with Apple ecosystem font stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif) and premium ceramic palette (#F5F5F7, #1D1D1F, #86868B, #D2D2D7)
New Hero Carousel component built with high-definition responsive lifestyle imagery, mobile touch responsiveness, slide indicators, and next/prev controls
Current interactive custom frame visualizer section positioned directly beneath the hero carousel as 'The Custom Frame Studio'
All page components (Header, Pills, Trust Bar, Collections, Journey, Atelier, Lookbook, FAQ, Footer) updated with the new premium palette
All Playwright tests pass (updated to reflect the new layout and styling)

steps.description: Update design tokens and Apple typography in globals.css and layout.tsx
steps.details: Switch palette to Apple ceramic #F5F5F7, ink #1D1D1F, muted #86868B, border #D2D2D7, and apply SF Pro font stack.
Create components/hero/hero-carousel.tsx with high-res lifestyle frame slides, mobile responsive aspect ratios, auto-advance, and touch swipe.

steps.description: Reposition Custom Frame Studio section below hero carousel
steps.details: Refactor hero-container.tsx into components/home/custom-frame-studio.tsx and place it beneath HeroCarousel in app/page.tsx.

steps.description: Harmonize all page components with new Apple-inspired styling
steps.details: Ensure headers, buttons, cards, pills, and footer reflect clean Apple precision and typography.

steps.description: Update and run Playwright verification tests
steps.details: Update test suites to verify hero carousel and reordered frame studio, run tests, and capture screenshots.
